packageRules.description: These update types have no release date, so Renovate cannot check their age. Without this rule the age check stays pending and Renovate never creates the branch.
A flake input that follows a Git ref has no release date, so its age cannot be checked.
The published packages declare ranges for their users: widen them only when a new release falls outside, and let uv.lock carry the exact versions.
The actions that the workflows pin by commit SHA, with the version in a comment: one pull request for all of them.
A security fix inside the declared range changes only the lock file. Renovate merges it after the checks pass.
Any other security fix changes a declared range or a major version. It opens as a draft pull request. A person reviews it, and Renovate never merges it.
